'''Jayke Ball BHBM NO MAINS FOR YOU''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10754">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10754 BHBM  NO MAINS FOR YOU], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 28 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10754/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10754/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018113057/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10754/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jayke Ball]]
* '''Published:''' 28 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''BHBM  NO MAINS FOR YOU''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}

* '''Strategy:''' You deny the opponet lots of force, while getting tons for you. You kill of all of their unique Males and thier hands.

== Original post ==

'''BHBM  NO MAINS FOR YOU'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' September 28, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' You deny the opponet lots of force, while getting tons for you. You kill of all of their unique Males and thier hands.

=== Strategy ===

Use the Docking bays for LOTS fo force for you, and none for them. Use myoom onith and Kill all thier unique Males. Then Monnok the doubles or lower them to 8 cards. Beatdown whoever they manage tog et out, and force drain in space. You may have trouble against Hidden Base, but try to kill of unique pilots at least. Have fun with this one.
